'''Ogathu''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], he served inside [[Darth Skotia's bunker]] on the planet of [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. He was the warden of the [[Trandoshan relic]] that [[Darth Skotia]] used to control his [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] bodyguards. He was killed by [[Darth Zash|Lord Zash's]] [[Darth Nox|apprentice]] when the Inquisitor [[Mission to Darth Skotia's bunker|infiltrated]] the base and bested him.
